items.title: 5.4.1 Instantaneous dipole-induced dipole forces (London dispersion forces) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.4.1, printed pages 98-100.

blocks.title: Instantaneous dipole-induced dipole force
blocks.text: Ek lamhati (instantaneous) dipole aur ek paida-karda (induced) dipole ke darmiyan lamhati kashish ki quwwat instantaneous dipole-induced dipole force (id-id) kehlati hai. Non-polar compounds ke molecules ke darmiyan sirf yehi forces maujood hain.

Jab compound ka molecular mass zyada ho to id-id forces mazboot hoti hain, aur ulat, kyunke bare atom ya molecule mein electron badal ka phailao aur us ka polarization asaan hai. Yeh aamil halogen aur noble gas families mein kaam karta hai: halogen family mein neeche jate hue size aur polarizability barhne se tabee halat badalti hai, fluorine aur chlorine gases hain, bromine liquid aur iodine solid (boiling point 458 K), aur noble gases ke boiling points helium se xenon tak barhte hain.

blocks.caption: Groups 17 aur 18 ke molar masses aur boiling points (Table 5.1)

blocks.text: Bare surface area wale molecule ke paas qareebi molecule se rabte ke zyada nuqte hain, to bare surface area wale molecules ke darmiyan forces mazboot hain. Saturated hydrocarbons mein, hydrogen se jure carbon atoms ki zanjeerein, ethane C2H6 -88.6 degrees C par aur hexane C6H14 68.7 degrees C par ubalta hai: lambe molecules ki lambai ke saath zyada jagahein hain jahan woh doosre molecules se khinch sakte hain. Pentane ke teen isomers ka relative molecular mass ek jaisa hai magar surface area mukhtalif: seedhi zanjeer wale n-pentane ka surface area sab se bara aur boiling point sab se zyada hai (36.2 degrees C), 2-methylbutane (isopentane) ka area chhota (28 degrees C), aur 2,2-dimethylpropane (neopentane) ka sab se chhota aur forces sab se kamzor (9.5 degrees C).

blocks.alt: C5H12 ke teen isomers ke carbon dhaanche, har molecule ki sateh ka rangeen khaaka. n-Pentane lambi zigzag zanjeer (boiling point 36.2 C), 2-methylbutane mein aik shaakh (28 C), aur 2,2-dimethylpropane taqreeban gend jaisa (9.5 C). Jitna zyada sateh ka rabta, utni mazboot London forces aur utna ooncha boiling point.
blocks.caption: Pentane ke teen isomers: mukhtalif shaklein, surface area aur boiling points (Figure 5.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
Kuch hydrocarbons ke boiling points aur tabee halatein (Table 5.2)

blocks.prompt: Petrol behtar banane ke liye petroleum ke gasoline hisse ke seedhi zanjeer wale hydrocarbons ko shakhdar (branched) mein badla jata hai. Wajah batayein, aur CCl4 aur SiF4 ke molecules ke darmiyan forces ke naam batayein.
blocks.explanation: Shakhdar molecules ka surface area chhota hai, to un ki London forces kamzor, boiling points kam aur woh asani se bukharat bante hain, jo engine mein jalne ke liye munasib hai. CCl4 aur SiF4 dono mutawazan, non-polar tetrahedral molecules hain, to un ke darmiyan sirf London (id-id) forces kaam karti hain.

items: London (id-id) forces: lamhati dipole doosra paida karta hai; non-polar molecules ke darmiyan wahid force.

Molecular mass aur size ke saath mazboot (F2 gas se I2 solid; He 4.22 K se Xe 165 K) aur surface area ke saath (methane -164 se decane 174.1 degrees C; n-pentane 36.2 > isopentane 28 > neopentane 9.5 degrees C).
